summary: Release-readiness AUDIT + REGRESSION pass for RoofSpan Field 'My Area'. Audited the applied code (backend GET /api/mobile/map/properties + _authorized_territory_ids; MapScreen loadMapProps/load/selectSection/MapErrorBoundary; mapDiagnostics scrubSecrets; canvass CACHE_* keys) and confirmed the invariants in-source. Extended two existing suites to LOCK RT1-RT5 + authorization as PERMANENT named tests: (a) backend tests/test_mobile_map_properties.py now has explicit test_RT1_no_canvass_assignment_returns_populated_or_valid_empty_state and test_RT_authorization_map_endpoint_does_not_widen_scope (sales set is a strict subset of management set, cross-territory p_b excluded from map AND 403 on detail); (b) mobile/src/tests/map_data_flow.node.test.js adds explicit RT1..RT5 named assertions plus STATIC WIRING checks against MapScreen.js source (loadMapProps catch does NOT putCache; selectSection is a pure setSelId setter; no catch path putCache's empty CACHE_MAP_PROPS/CFG/SECTIONS). Ran the related regression suites end-to-end: backend test_mobile_map_properties (8/8), test_canvass_sections (10/10), test_mobile_api (10/10) = 28/28 PASS. Mobile pure-Node: map_diagnostics 33/33, map_data_flow 48/48 (was 27, added 21 RT-named), canvass 11/11, mapconfig 44/44, sketch_cache 15/15, sync (live) 6/6, sync_diagnostics PASS, sync_status 5/5, transport 8/8, pairing 11/11, refresh PASS, scope 7/7. No defects introduced or found; no code paths clear the master property collection or valid cache. Environment limits honored and reported: mobile/node_modules is NOT installed (only 3 stub folders) — Expo Doctor, Metro bundling, native Android/iOS builds CANNOT run in this container and are NOT claimed passing. Physical-device acceptance for MapLibre v10 on Expo SDK 57 / RN 0.86 is still required for release sign-off.
action_items: PENDING (out-of-scope; container-blocked): install mobile/node_modules on a real dev/build host, then run 'npx expo-doctor' and an EAS Android + iOS dev-client build to confirm MapLibre v10 native module initializes on Expo SDK 57 / RN 0.86. If it fails, the redacted diagnostic will now be captured in getCache('map_diag_last') and surfaced by Diagnostics.js (testID=diag-map-renderer).

OPTIONAL (spec-clarification, not a defect): _authorized_territory_ids grants TERRITORY-wide map visibility to a sales user, while property-detail (assert_property_access) enforces stricter SECTION/lead/job membership. Both scopes are enforced server-side; the map is intentionally a wider 'overview' scope. If product wants map scope == detail scope, tighten mobile.mobile_map_properties to join CanvassSectionProperty and UNION Lead.property_id / Job.property_id. Documented but NOT changed since the current behavior matches the review's explicit RT1 wording (zero-section sales -> 200 empty FC) and 'sales gets territories where they have an assigned active canvass section'.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/mobile.py mobile_map_properties still issues a per-property N+1 sub-select for the last Visit (lines 617-619). Fine at current scale; recommend a single windowed query (DISTINCT ON property_id ORDER BY visited_at DESC) for larger territories.

MapScreen.load() uses Promise.all + per-promise .catch(() => ({ok:false})) which is semantically identical to Promise.allSettled since no rejection escapes. Failure isolation invariant holds; cosmetic-only comment.

loadMapProps catch path correctly reads CACHE_MAP_PROPS and never putCache's on failure (statically asserted by RT3 wiring check). selectSection is literally 'setSelId(id)' (statically asserted by RT4 wiring check). Both are the exact invariants the review requires.

mapDiagnostics.scrubSecrets is defense-in-depth; the primary secret-avoidance is at the recordMapError call site (only passes !!ticket, never raw keys/tokens). Redaction contract tests pass (33 assertions).
recordMapError is wrapped in try/catch AND the MapErrorBoundary.componentDidCatch is also try/catch when forwarding to props.onError. Diagnostics can never crash the app.
